description: Get one West Virginia administrative rule family by title-series (e.g. "11-01B"): every version ever filed with its effective date, status (Active, Historical, Emergency), authorizing statute, and the filing history (modified/agency-approved/legislative-approval filings) with document ids that read_rule_text can open. Use after search_rules to see the current rule and what superseded it.

document.description: Optionally, a rule version document number from search_rules to list that version's filings instead.

name: get_rule
